text_block_list.text:
When I stepped into the cafe with Gold 
Ship, we spotted Tap Dance City.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Cool. Every single one of these is pure 
romance.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a photo book of castles? You're 
reading something pretty interesting, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. For reference for my future castle. 
Castle styles really vary from country to 
country!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Castles, right! I saw plenty in France! 
I've been thinking about setting up an 
overseas base, y'know~

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I've crossed the ocean before, ya know. 
Riding on the back of an orca.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It's just common maritime sense. How 
else are you supposed to cross the ocean 
if not on an orca?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, classic you! But a voyage without a 
chart, huh? Nice, let me hear all the 
details!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sure. —Riding on an orca, I arrived 
at the mouth of the Seine, and then swam 
upstream myself...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright! We've arrived, party party 
party!! Let's go snag ourselves a base of 
operations!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh! Hey-heyyy!

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: ... Moi ?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh-oh, yeah, yeah. Hey you, yeah you. Are 
you free à la mode right now?

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
Pardon ? Parlez-vous français ? Um... Do 
you speak English?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Delphinidae Orcinus, from afar she hath 
arrived, now step forth!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: WANT BASE-U! FIND-U CRAZY BIG MANSION-U!

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... They're tourists, right...? I 
wonder if they're lost?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
GOLSHI SEND, GRATITUDE AND, SINCERITY 
MARCO POLO! GIMME, REAL ESTATE INFOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: ... Ah, un château ! D'accord !

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...And that's how they showed me around 
castles all over France. When you're 
house-hunting, asking the locals really is 
the best way to go!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Amazing!! Not bad! You completely 
shattered the language barrier!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I don't hate that side of you at all! That 
rampage of yours puts fairytale pirates to 
shame!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course. Anyway, when they showed 
me to my favorite castle—

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"How do you like it? This beautiful 
garden! The view from the royal window is 
so colorful and magnificent!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whaddya mean, not a clue-o, buongiorno!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Still, I like it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A downpour of gratitude for your guidance! 
Truly appreciated! I shall never forget 
this favor until I take three steps!

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: “You're very welcome!”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's put it up! The nameplate!
(THUD!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Peace-peace☆ This belongs to Golshi-chan 
now~♪

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"That photo board... you want to take a 
commemorative picture with it, don't you? 
Okay, hand me your phone!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
An ID photo to prove you're my new master, 
huh? Look at you, thinkin' ahead!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well then, now that we've got a base, how 
about we go look for something fun to do!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! That punchline is so you! What a 
masterpiece! Tell me another one 
sometime!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you want seconds, do you? Don't worry, 
I'll whip up a full-course meal for ya!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Using that castle as my base, I'm gonna 
tour Europe with nothing but a single 
kitchen knife!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No need for words, let skill do the 
talking! Leave it all to Head Chef 
Golshi!!

It's an outrageous idea, but I can feel 
bottomless confidence in Gold Ship's tone. 
We can take on the world—she made me feel 
that once again.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I'm going to negotiate with 
the government!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Give me your address next time we meet! 
I'll pack up my gratitude and heartfelt 
thanks in a paulownia box and send it 
right over!"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, are you all done already? Have fun 
sightseeing in France!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And when I went to see the president, I 
was blocked by a wall of muscle-bound guys 
in tight suits!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The crowd was so ridiculously dense, I 
couldn't even catch a glimpse of the 
President's face... Damn it!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You've gotta build your own castle with 
your own two hands— using the fame and 
fortune you've won!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"You've learned a valuable lesson, Golshi! 
Build it yourself and show 'em all!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, I'm doing this! You just 
reminded me of the crushing pressure from 
those muscleheads back then!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna unleash a worldwide Golshi-chan 
fever, let's GOOOOOOOO!

Once the switch is flipped, nobody can 
stop Gold Ship. With this kind of 
explosive power, she could take on the 
world—she reminded me of that once again.
